readme: Search progress log for quotle.info. Baseline 2026-07-25 = the day Google first read a sitemap. Readings are APPEND-ONLY and stamped with the DATA date (GSC lags ~2 days). Read the cohort split, not the site totals: totals blend the Jul 7-10 legacy pages with the current product. See tools/search-log.js for why.

cohorts.definition: legacy = created on/before 2026-07-10; current = created after it

readings.source: GSC URL-prefix property https://quotle.info/ · 3-month window (contains only 2026-07-08..07-23 — the property has no earlier data)
readings.milestone: BASELINE. 2026-07-25 is the first day Google ever successfully read a sitemap for this site (sitemap-full.xml, Success, 2,048 discovered). Everything before this had no discovery path except internal links.

current.note: NOT MEASURED — GSC's rows-per-page control would not expand the Pages table past 10 rows. Bounded evidence instead: all 10 top pages (1,105 of 3,510 impressions) were created 2026-07-07..07-09, i.e. legacy. Use EXPORT->CSV for an exact split.

querySegments.caveat: These sum to 1,464 impressions, not 3,510 — GSC anonymises rare queries, so the query table always undercounts. Compare segment SHARES across readings, never absolute totals.

expertNavigational.note: names a source the searcher already wants: Quote Investigator, Garson O'Toole, Ralph Keyes, Wikiquote, or hunts a citation ('page 87', '1925'). Zero CTR is the CORRECT outcome — we are not the source they asked for. Not a target; do not optimise.

bareQuoteText.note: someone pastes a line into Google — the core use case. Largest bucket, worst position.

rights.note: the single match is a false positive ('...without your permission' is the Roosevelt quote). Genuine reuse-rights demand measured at ZERO across 667 queries; Bing's four suggested keywords for this site are likewise all attribution. Rights is a differentiator on-page, not an acquisition channel.

sitemap.deadEntry: https://quotle.info/sitemap.xml — permanently 'Couldn't fetch', un-removable, ignore it

readings.notes: Do NOT read these figures as a verdict on the site. 207 of 2,048 pages have ever earned an impression and the top 10 are all Jul 7-9 records, whose content shape the operator says is not comparable to the current product. The 695 current-cohort records start from ~0 here by construction. Chart also shows impressions falling toward zero after 7/19 — unresolved at baseline; likely GSC reporting lag on recent days, confirm at the next reading before treating as a drop.

indexing.note: The Page indexing report has RECOVERED — it was frozen on a 2026-07-09 snapshot for weeks (Google-side reporting outage) and is now current to 07-20. Indexed 289 -> 319. 'Page with redirect' jumped 13 -> 97: expected fallout of the URL-contract fix (old no-slash URLs now 301 to the slash form and Google reclassifies them), not a new defect — but confirm it stops growing.

sitemap.note: Google is now re-reading it DAILY (read 7/26 and 7/27). The fix is holding.

current.note: still not exactly measured (GSC pagination). Bounded: all 10 top pages remain legacy — the two new top-10 entrants were created 2026-07-07 and 07-09.

readings.notes: TWO DAYS POST-SITEMAP-FIX; too early for indexing effect (~4d publish->index latency, and the sitemap was first read 7/25). Coverage barely moved: 207->216 pages with impressions, of 2,048. THE 7/19 DROP IS REAL, NOT REPORTING LAG — the baseline flagged it as unconfirmed; with data now through 7/25 it persists. Impressions ran ~420/day through 7/18, collapsed to ~30/day by 7/20, stayed flat, and turned up slightly on 7/24-25. Leading candidate is new-site honeymoon decay (classic shape: ramp, plateau, sharp pullback), NOT the sitemap — the collapse predates every sitemap change. Unresolved; do not act on it until a third reading shows whether the 7/24-25 uptick continues.

readings.source: GSC URL-prefix property https://quotle.info/ · 28-day window (7/8–8/4; the property still has no data before 7/8, so 28-day == full history and IS comparable to the 3-month totals in the two prior readings)

recent7d.note: First reading where the clean-window cohort split was actually measured — GSC's rows-per-page finally expanded to show all 76 rows. Prior readings could only bound it.

cohort.measuredOn: the 7-day window 7/29–8/04, all 76 rows read, split against the frozen legacy slug list

current.note: 6 of 867 non-legacy quote pages. Denominator is all quote records not in the frozen legacy list (1,385 total - 518 legacy), not the frozen 695.

cohort.caveat: Page-level rows sum to 408 vs the 389 totals card — GSC computes the two differently. Treat the split as a ratio (90% legacy / 10% current), not as exact counts.

indexing.note: THE PAGE INDEXING REPORT IS FROZEN AGAIN — 'Last update: 7/23/26', read on 8/6, 14 days stale, and the indexed/not-indexed figures (319/202) are byte-identical to the 2026-07-25 reading. This is the same Google-side reporting freeze documented in tools/search-log.js. Do NOT re-read 319/202 as a measurement. Note 319+202=521, which is roughly the legacy cohort alone — the report never covered the 2,367-URL corpus. Performance data by contrast is fresh (updated 5h before the pull).

urlInspection.note: All three are present in sitemap-full.xml and return HTTP 200 at the canonical trailing-slash URL. So the two uncrawled ones are not a build defect — Google has parsed the sitemap file but has not scheduled these URLs for crawl, and does not even attribute them to a sitemap. 'Discovered pages: 2,361' on the sitemap row means URLs PARSED from the file, not URLs crawled.

sitemap.deadEntry: https://quotle.info/sitemap.xml — still 'Couldn't fetch', never read, 0 discovered. Known and worked around; robots.txt documents it.

readings.notes: THE 7/19 COLLAPSE NEVER RECOVERED. Third reading, and the answer to the question the 7/25 reading left open is no: impressions ran ~420/day through 7/18 and have sat at ~50/day for 17 straight days (389 over 7 days). The 7/24-25 uptick did not continue. Site totals still LOOK like they rise (3510 -> 3680 -> 4260) purely because the window is cumulative — the daily rate is flat and low. THE REAL FINDING IS THE COHORT SPLIT, measured exactly for the first time: 90% of impressions still come from the 518 legacy pages, and only 6 of 867 current-cohort pages (0.7%) earned a single impression in the last week. Page coverage across the whole corpus is 237 of 2,367 (10%), up just 21 in the ten days since the last reading, while ~180 new pages were published in the same period. Live URL inspection confirms the mechanism: recently published pages are 'unknown to Google' — never crawled, no sitemap attribution — despite being in a sitemap Google re-reads daily. Discovery is not the bottleneck any more (the sitemap fix held); CRAWL SCHEDULING is. Google is reading the sitemap and declining to fetch the URLs in it. Still zero clicks on the current build. Do not read '5 clicks' as progress — all 5 belong to the legacy cohort and the count has not moved since 7/23. || AMENDED 2026-08-06 after pulling GSC Crawl stats: the crawl-scheduling diagnosis is now measured, not inferred. Googlebot made 2,420 requests total; the rate collapsed from ~830/day (7/8-7/9) to ~20-40/day from 7/11 onward and has stayed flat. Host status is clean and response time 84ms, so this is crawl DEMAND, not host throttling. NOTE FOR THE NEXT READING: quotle.info is served by GitHub Pages/Fastly, NOT Cloudflare (server: GitHub.com, no cf-ray) — there are no origin access logs available, so Crawl stats is the only Googlebot-volume instrument. Do not go looking for Cloudflare logs for these pages; the Cloudflare worker is the /verify API on a different host. ALSO FIXED THIS SESSION: tools/build-sitemap.js stamped every author, theme and static page with the corpus-wide newest dateModified, so ~900 URLs claimed to change on every build; now derived per page (896 -> 14 URLs carrying the build date). Whether that churn contributed to the crawl collapse is UNKNOWN — it is a signal-quality fix, not a diagnosed cause, and the next reading is the test.

crawlStats.note: GSC Settings -> Crawl stats. FRESH (last updated 8/4) while the Page indexing report is frozen at 7/23 — this is the instrument to use.
crawlStats.hostStatus: Host had no problems in the last 90 days
crawlStats.shape: THE ROOT CAUSE, VISIBLE DIRECTLY. Crawling spiked to ~830 requests/day on 7/8-7/9, collapsed by 7/11, and has run at roughly 20-40/day ever since — a flat line for ~24 days. At that rate one pass over 2,367 URLs takes ~3 months, which is exactly why 6 of 867 current-cohort pages have impressions. The crawl collapse (~7/10) PRECEDES the impressions collapse (~7/19) by about nine days, the expected lag.
crawlStats.notThrottling: Host status clean for 90 days and average response 84ms, so Google is not backing off for host health. This is crawl DEMAND (how much Google thinks the site is worth fetching), not crawl CAPACITY.
crawlStats.waste: 16% of an already-tiny budget returns 301. Internal links were checked and are clean — zero no-slash quote hrefs in the built HTML — so these are Google re-crawling no-slash URLs it learned before the 2026-07-22 contract fix. Self-limiting, should decay. 26% goes to non-HTML (16% other + 10% JSON): llms.txt and openapi.json are deliberate agent surfaces, but the large unlinked build artifacts in the web root (verify-index.json 1.8MB, themes.json 833KB, search.json 456KB, manifest.json 539KB) are NOT disallowed in robots.txt. Untested as a crawl-budget factor; flagged, not diagnosed.

readings.source: GSC domain property sc-domain:quotle.info · clean 7-day window 8/2–8/8 (both properties now show identical Performance data; prior readings used the URL-prefix property)
readings.milestone: FIRST CLICK EVER ON THE CURRENT BUILD — homepage, from the 8/2–8/8 window. Also: first external link in the Links report (tokusuke-life.com → homepage, anchor 'quotle quote context engine', organic), and the first manual-request cohort proved out: /themes/, /who-recorded/ and god-does-not-play-dice all flipped from unindexed/unknown on 8/7 to 'URL is on Google' by 8/10 (3/3 spot-checked).

indexing.note: Report UNFROZE ~8/8 and now covers the full corpus for the first time (was 319/202 legacy-only while frozen). Indexed 329 (8/8) -> 338 (8/10). discoveredNotIndexed rising is EXPECTED — it is the whole current build becoming visible in the report while awaiting crawl. crawledNotIndexed 12 -> 22 shows crawl activity ahead of admission. The 'Page with redirect / validation Failed' state is permanent and benign: those are the old no-slash URLs 301ing by design; that validation can never pass — do not act on it.

externalLinks.note: FIRST EVER (was 0 on 8/7). Not the gameshelf footer link yet — that shipped 8/7 and is expected in this report ~8/21+. Internal links known to Google: 840 -> 1,114.

manualIndexing.spotChecks: 3/3 of the 8/7 batch indexed by 8/10 (/themes/, /who-recorded/, god-does-not-play-dice)
manualIndexing.note: Nightly task quotle-index-requests exists but its 8/9 run appended nothing to the state file and the 8/10 run did not fire (app closed at 1am). The 10/day quota went unused on 8/9 and 8/10 pending pre-approval of the task's browser tools ('Run now' once).

readings.notes: PROGRESS IS NOW MEASURABLE AND ATTRIBUTABLE. Three days after the 8/7 interventions (crawlable game->info footer link, honest per-page lastmod, first 10 manual crawl requests): indexed 329->338, all three spot-checked requested pages admitted, first external link recorded, first current-build click, avg position 22.3->15.0, pages-with-impressions/7d 76->106. Daily crawl rate ticked up only modestly (~10-17/day vs the ~2-5 trough of 8/1, still far below the ~830 honeymoon peak) — the deep crawl-demand constraint is NOT solved; what changed is that explicitly queued pages get fetched within ~1-3 days, so the 10/day manual quota is currently the most reliable lever. Impressions/day ~58 vs ~54 prior week: flat-to-slightly-up, not yet a trend. Do not declare recovery until the crawl-rate series rises without manual pushes and the current cohort earns impressions broadly.
